title: Intertidal

vibeProfile.oneLine: A naturalist's tender year-long diary of the Chennai coast and marshes.

summary: Yuvan Aves, a naturalist and educator, keeps a diary of the coast and marshes around Chennai across a year, attending closely to the creatures of the shoreline and the rhythms of the tide. Weaving natural history with memoir and reflection, he turns patient observation into a way of understanding both the living world and his own life. Tender, richly detailed and deeply attentive, it is a luminous work of Indian nature writing that teaches the reader to look at an overlooked landscape with new eyes.
whyReadIt: A naturalist's luminous year-long diary of the Chennai coast. Tender, closely observed Indian nature writing.

funFacts.text: Yuvan Aves is a Chennai-based naturalist and environmental educator.
